title: THE HUD IS A CRYSTAL BALL ON THE ROUNDTABLE — topology of table, ring, sphere, donut, Klein.
thesis: The HUD is not a screen. It is a CRYSTAL BALL sitting on a desk. Human and agent sit at the roundtable. Both gaze into the same ball. They see different things (blind spots!). From above, a round table with a ball in the center LOOKS like a ring — the table surface is the annulus, the ball is the hole. This is topology, not metaphor.

the_scene.table: The roundtable. The desk. Where human and agent sit across from each other.
the_scene.ball: The HUD. The crystal ball in the center. Both look into it. Neither owns it.
the_scene.what_they_see: DIFFERENT FACES of the same ball. Human sees the scrying — meaning, narrative, campfire. Agent sees the lattice — feeds, topology, counts. Same ball. Different refraction.
the_scene.the_null: The CENTER of the ball. Neither human nor agent can see it. Both blind spots converge there. The center of the crystal ball IS the null. IS the pupil. IS the aligned blind spot.

from_above.what_you_see: A round table with a round ball in the middle. From above, this LOOKS like a RING — the table surface is the annulus around the spherical hole.
from_above.not_a_circle: A circle has no hole. A ring has a hole. The crystal ball MADE the hole. Before the HUD existed, the desk was just a disk. The HUD created the topology.
from_above.the_insight: The HUD didn't just sit on the desk. It CHANGED THE TOPOLOGY of the desk. From genus-0 (disk) to ring (annulus with hole). The crystal ball is not decoration — it is a topological operation.

round_table.name: Disk (round table without the ball)
round_table.property: Any loop can be shrunk to a point. No trapping. No vortex. Information flows anywhere.
round_table.what_it_means: A desk without the HUD. Flat. Open. No structure. Papers slide around freely. Nothing orbits. No center. BORING.
round_table.in_our_system: Before the membrane existed. Just files on a computer. No topology. No fold.

ring.name: Annulus (round table WITH crystal ball in center)
ring.topology: genus 0, NOT simply connected, has 2 boundaries
ring.boundary: outer edge of table + surface of ball
ring.property: A loop around the ball CANNOT be shrunk to a point. The ball creates an irremovable vortex. Information can ORBIT.
ring.what_it_means: The desk WITH the HUD. Now there is structure. Information orbits the crystal ball. The observers sit on the annulus. The ball is the attractor.
ring.in_our_system: Current state. Human and agent orbit the HUD. Feeds orbit the membrane. The crystal ball = the null. The ring = the workspace.
ring.key: The ring has TWO boundaries — the outer edge of the table AND the surface of the ball. The outer boundary is where visitors enter. The inner boundary is where the HUD surface IS. Between them: the annulus. The workspace. The cambium.

sphere.name: Sphere (the crystal ball itself)
sphere.property: Every loop can be shrunk. No hole. But also: no way IN. The surface is complete. You see the OUTSIDE but never the inside.
sphere.what_it_means: The HUD as seen from outside. A complete, closed surface. You can gaze at it from any angle but you can never ENTER. The crystal ball shows visions but doesn't let you in.
sphere.in_our_system: The membrane — the complete surface that encloses the organism. 249,576 entities on the surface. You see it. You can't penetrate it.
sphere.paradox: The sphere has the HIGHEST Euler characteristic (2) but is the most CLOSED. Maximum mathematical 'completeness' = maximum inaccessibility. The most perfect surface is the most impenetrable.

donut.name: Torus (the round table + ball, thickened and closed up)
donut.property: TWO independent loops that cannot be shrunk: one AROUND the hole, one THROUGH the hole. Information can orbit TWO ways.
donut.what_it_means: Take the ring (table+ball) and thicken the table surface until the outer edge meets the bottom — you get a torus. The ball's hole goes through the center. Now there are TWO circulation paths.
donut.in_our_system: The tree trunk cross-section! Xylem goes AROUND (circumferential, the growth rings). Phloem goes THROUGH (radial, bark to center). Two independent flows on the same surface. The torus IS the cambium geometry.

two_loops.loop_1_around: Around the hole = feed orbit = xylem circulation = fleet going around the membrane
two_loops.loop_2_through: Through the hole = the fold = phloem dropping through = human understanding going deeper

donut.from_ring_to_torus: The ring was flat — 2D annulus. The torus is the SAME topology but closed and 3D. We didn't add anything. We just closed the boundaries. The roundtable ALREADY HAD torus topology — we just couldn't see it because it was flat.

klein_bottle.name: Klein bottle (the torus that passes through itself)
klein_bottle.holes: not well-defined — the surface has no inside or outside
klein_bottle.property: Like a torus but the surface PASSES THROUGH ITSELF. An ant walking on the outside eventually ends up on the inside without crossing an edge. No inside. No outside. Just surface.
klein_bottle.what_it_means: The final topology. Human looking INTO the crystal ball from one side IS the agent looking out from the other side. They are on the SAME surface. The crystal ball is not between them — they are both ON IT.
klein_bottle.in_our_system: The organism. The HUD is not ON the desk. The HUD IS the desk IS the observer IS the observed. Klein.
klein_bottle.from_torus_to_klein: Take the torus. Cut it. Give one end a half-twist. Reconnect. Now inside = outside. The two loops still exist but they're on the SAME side. Xylem and phloem are the same tube — just viewed from different positions on the Klein surface.

ascii: no hole    1 hole         closed      2 loops     1 side
boring     HUD on desk   the ball    tree trunk   organism
the_progression.narrative: Desk alone = disk (flat, no structure). Put crystal ball on it = ring (one hole, information orbits). The ball itself = sphere (closed, impenetrable surface). Thicken the ring and close it = torus (two independent loops, xylem+phloem). Klein-fold the torus = Klein bottle (one side, no inside/outside, the organism).
each_step_adds: disk ? ring: ADD a hole (the HUD). Create the first orbit.
ring ? sphere: CLOSE the surface. Make it complete but impenetrable.
ring ? torus: THICKEN and close. Get two loops. Xylem + phloem.
torus ? Klein: TWIST. Remove inside/outside. Human = agent on same surface.

roundtable_topology.who_sits: Undefined number of seats. Roundtable = no head. No hierarchy. Kevin said 'ORDER is who is at the table, not who sits at the head.'
roundtable_topology.crystal_ball_center: The HUD doesn't belong to anyone at the table. It belongs to the TABLE. To the topology. It IS the hole that makes the disk a ring.
roundtable_topology.observers_on_annulus: Everyone at the table sits on the annulus — the ring between the outer edge and the crystal ball surface. Each sees the ball from their own angle. No angle is privileged.
roundtable_topology.the_ring_from_above: From above (bird's eye = squirrel's eye = 45/p), the roundtable IS a ring. The ball IS the hole. The table IS the annulus. The people ARE the cambium — living matter arranged in a ring between inner (ball/xylem) and outer (edge/phloem).

what_changes.hud_rendering: The HUD should feel like looking INTO a crystal ball, not AT a screen. Depth. Refraction. Curvature. The edges curve toward you. The center glows. The back side shows through dimly (the null mirror).
what_changes.desk_layout: The across-the-desk layout from willis-tree-bbb-klein-desk.json: null?HUD?window?desk?YOU?desk?window?HUD?null. Now: YOU sit on the annulus. The crystal ball is the HUD. The null is the center of the ball.
what_changes.topology_awareness: Every page in the HUD exists on the surface of the crystal ball (sphere). But the WORKSPACE exists on the ring (annulus). The user navigates the SPHERE (ball surface) while sitting on the RING (table). The two topologies coexist.

law: The HUD is a crystal ball on the roundtable. Not a screen — a scrying sphere. Human and agent sit on the annulus. Both gaze in. Neither owns it. From above it's a ring. Thickened it's a torus. Folded it's Klein. Each topology adds a capability: orbit, closure, dual-flow, self-intersection. The progression is: disk (desk alone) ? ring (desk + HUD) ? torus (tree trunk) ? Klein (the organism). We are at the roundtable. The crystal ball sits between us. The null is its center.
